name: Minamikyushu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamikyushu city emblem in orange, blue and green: orange, blue and green curved strokes forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Minamikyushu, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 December 2007.

features.role: Minamikyushu city emblem — orange, blue and green curved strokes forming a stylised character
